dataRoles.description: Drop every dimension a user should be able to switch between (Department, Gender, Location, Band...). They appear in the built-in dropdown on the visual header - no field parameter or bookmark needed.
dataRoles.name: dimension

dataRoles.description: Optional. Fields the second dropdown offers as the series split. Leave empty and that dropdown falls back to the Dimensions bucket.
dataRoles.name: dimension2

dataRoles.description: A single date column. The visual derives Month / Quarter / Fiscal Year itself for the Monthly-Quarterly-Annual switch.
dataRoles.name: date

dataRoles.description: Optional. A column whose values label the axis while the Annual button is active - a custom label like "FY 26-27" instead of the derived bucket. Mapping it also makes the Annual button available without a Date field.
dataRoles.name: annualLabel

dataRoles.description: Optional. A column whose values label the axis while the Quarterly button is active, e.g. "Q1 Jan-Mar 26-27".
dataRoles.name: quarterlyLabel

dataRoles.description: Optional. A column whose values label the axis while the Monthly button is active, e.g. "Apr 2026".
dataRoles.name: monthlyLabel

dataRoles.description: Table view only. The primary field the table lists by (Employee Name), plus optional further levels which become expandable child rows. When empty the table falls back to showing the chart's data.
dataRoles.name: tableRows

dataRoles.description: Table view only. Attribute columns shown against each row (Department, Designation, Date of Joining...). These cost no extra query rows when they are attributes of the Table rows field.
dataRoles.name: tableColumns

dataRoles.description: Field that splits each column into stacked segments.
dataRoles.name: legend

dataRoles.description: Measure(s) to plot. With no Legend field, multiple values stack against each other.
dataRoles.name: measure

dataRoles.description: Combo charts only. Measure(s) drawn as a line over the columns, on the secondary axis. Leave empty for every other chart type.
dataRoles.name: lineMeasure

dataRoles.description: Scatter only. The measure plotted along the horizontal axis. Ignored by every other chart type.
dataRoles.name: xMeasure

dataRoles.description: Scatter only. The measure plotted up the vertical axis. Ignored by every other chart type.
dataRoles.name: yMeasure

dataRoles.description: Optional, scatter only. A measure that sizes each bubble. Leave it empty for a plain scatter of equal-sized points.
dataRoles.name: sizeMeasure

dataRoles.description: Optional. A measure returning the sentence shown in the insight banner. Write it at total level (REMOVEFILTERS / ALLSELECTED over the axis fields) so every row of the query carries the same sentence.
dataRoles.name: insight

dataRoles.description: Extra measures shown in the tooltip only.
dataRoles.name: tooltip

enumeration.displayName: Same row as the dimension selector
